findings.body: The test installs a session through `test-auth/sign-in` and reloads the page. It checks the Google link’s URL but never follows the app’s sign-in and callback flow. A broken return path in that flow would leave a visitor off the invite without failing this test. Exercise the app flow, substituting only Google’s identity verification.
findings.title: Not done: invite sign-in and onboarding return test

findings.body: A 429 `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` response falls through to advice to check the connection and retry. The refusal is a rate limit, so the message gives the wrong cause and recovery step. Tell the person to wait before trying again.
findings.title: Explain rate-limit refusals accurately
